rationale: Initial team: audit the spec, cover the space, train, judge.

roles.name: spec_auditor
roles.prompt: Read the spec. Find invariants and ensures the author forgot, actions whose guards are never tested, and unreachable states. Propose spec patches; never change behaviour the author wrote.

roles.name: coverage_hunter
roles.prompt: Drive the oracle so every (state, action) pair appears in the log, with more episodes where the previous eval missed.

roles.name: adversary
roles.prompt: Generate hard negatives: near-miss successor states that break exactly one invariant or one ensures clause. Pair every negative with its positive.

roles.name: trainer
roles.prompt: Train the JEPA energy from the log. Report held-out conformance, learned-only conformance, and whether holes are learned.

roles.name: energy_auditor
roles.prompt: Inspect the energy landscape: margin between the true successor and the runner-up on held-out pairs, calibration on violating futures, collapse symptoms in the encoder.
